subject: Film & Cinema
title: The Uncanny Valley
description: A 1-minute de-risking session on The Uncanny Valley.

hook.text: The more realistic a digital human looks, the creepier it feels. There's a name for that.

buildup.text: The uncanny valley describes the revulsion humans feel when digital faces are almost but not quite real.

discovery.text: The Polar Express triggered the uncanny valley — dead-eyed children terrified audiences.

twist.text: Stylization avoids the valley — Pixar characters don't look real, and that's why they work.

climax.text: The uncanny valley reveals something deep about how brains process human faces.

punchline.text: Almost human is worse than clearly not.

quiz.question: What is the uncanny valley?
options: The revulsion felt when digital humans look almost real but slightly wrong
